reason: The key premises are directly and accurately supported by the cited evidence E3 and E4, which explicitly state the formation of isolated Pt/Pd sites, charge transfer to noble metals, and enhanced nitrobenzene interaction and hydrogenation activity. E1 and E2 provide general support for HEA catalytic performance but do not address the specific mechanistic premises.
premises: Alloying noble metals with non-noble transition metals in HEAs forms isolated noble metal active sites
Charge transfer occurs from non-noble transition metals to noble metals in these HEAs
This charge transfer enhances the interaction between the catalyst and reactant (e.g., nitrobenzene)
The enhanced interaction leads to improved catalytic performance (activity/stability)
